title: The hyperimmune-free truth-table proof must bound the computation modulus u.
details: Cenzer–Remmel2017, Theorem1.9.13 proof p24, visually checked. After defining u(n) as the least finite-prefix allowance witnessing the computation, the text obtains a computable h with g(n) at most h(n); it must obtain u(n) at most h(n). Hyperimmune-freeness applies because u is computable from g. Definition1.6.4(iii), pp14–15, includes the prefix-length resource bound, so testing failure at the supplied finite prefix is decidable; no stronger all-oracle convergence hypothesis is needed after the corrected bound. The corpus uses an explicit bounded evaluator resource to keep this convention visible.
